title: 1991 NBA Hoops #527 Shawn Kemp Seattle Supersonics Illustrated Team Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This is a 1991 NBA Hoops trading card featuring Shawn Kemp of the Seattle Supersonics. The card showcases an illustrated team design and is part of the base set. It is made of card stock and does not have an autograph. The card is vintage and from the National Basketball Association (NBA). It is card number #527 in the set.
